title: Flutter app scaffold and test harness
description: As a developer I need a buildable Flutter app with a test runner so each requirement has a runnable test
acceptance_criteria: App builds on the target platform; test command runs and reports per requirement ID

title: Time model
description: As a user I want event times stored in UTC with their zone and shown in my Local zone and format
acceptance_criteria: TIM-01; TIM-02; TIM-03; TIM-04; TIM-05; TIM-06; TIM-10 each pass their tests

title: Theme tokens and fonts
description: As a user I want the light and dark Soft palette and IBM Plex fonts

title: Shared dropdown and instant apply
description: As a user I want one dropdown behaviour and changes shown at once

title: Month view and navigation
description: As a user I want a Month calendar I can navigate with today marked
acceptance_criteria: CAL-01.a; CAL-01.b (Month and Week only); CAL-01.d; CAL-01.i pass

title: Week view hourly grid
description: As a user I want a Week view with an hourly grid and week navigation

title: Remaining views and view picker
description: As a user I want 5-day Day and List views and an icon view picker
acceptance_criteria: Rest of CAL-01.b; CAL-06.c; CAL-01.j pass

title: Calendar filter
description: As a user I want to filter calendars

title: Message keys and localization
description: As a user I want every message in my language from the message files
acceptance_criteria: Messages are read from requirements/messages/*.arb by key; a missing key falls back to English (msg: rows SHL-02.a-b); the picker/header messages in sprint 002 are cited by key
